prompts.name: hello
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE digital cartoon mascot asset for a student productivity app. Input photo is SUBJECT REFERENCE ONLY, ignore all phone UI and workshop surroundings. Character inspired by the actual handmade white desktop robot: compact off-white rounded cube lower body, two circular dark sensor eyes on FRONT OF LOWER BODY, small horizontal dark segmented display beneath eyes, two tiny lower circular details, open white U-shaped upper cradle, a large blank white rounded cube head mounted above on a tiny neck. Keep this distinctive stacked two-box silhouette. Give it tiny friendly articulated stubby arms and small feet as cartoon liberties. Clean expressive 2D/soft cel-shaded illustration, charcoal fine outlines, warm ivory, subtle mint accent, very restrained shadows, sophisticated cute indie-app style, no photorealism. The upper cube is blank, the face is on the lower body. Single full-body character centered in a square canvas with 12 percent padding. Genuine transparent alpha background; no paper, sticker sheet, die-cut white border, photograph frame, drop shadow rectangle, labels, words, watermark or logos. Pose: cheerful welcoming pose with one tiny arm raised in a wave, upper cube tilted gently to the side, front three-quarter view.
